product_overview: WORKTIME Frontend is an RTL-first attendance and workforce management web app for employees and managers. It supports account access, attendance check-in/out, and an admin workspace for monitoring workforce status and managing organizational records.
core_goals: Allow users to sign in and create an account
Let employees record attendance by checking in and checking out
Give managers a dashboard to review attendance summaries
Enable managers to browse employee and attendance information
Support department management within the admin workspace

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can access the system by signing in with email and password, or create a new account through registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/login -> Fill in email credentials -> Fill in password credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the home redirect after successful authentication
Navigate to /workTime-fornt/login -> Fill in incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an invalid credentials error message
Navigate to /workTime-fornt/signup -> Fill in the registration form -> Submit the registration form -> See validation feedback for invalid input

features.name: Attendance Check-in and Check-out
features.description: Employees can view their current shift timing, monitor the shift countdown, and record attendance actions for arrival and departure.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/attendance-departure-check -> View the current shift countdown and attendance status -> Check in -> See the attendance status update
Navigate to /workTime-fornt/attendance-departure-check -> View the current shift countdown and attendance status -> Check out -> See the attendance status update

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Managers can review an attendance overview from the dashboard and move into employee details from the summary view.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/dashboard -> View the employee attendance summary -> Open employee details from the overview

features.name: Employee Directory and Profiles
features.description: Managers can browse employee records and open individual employee profile details from the management area.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/employees -> Review the employee list -> Search or scan through employees -> Open an employee profile
Navigate to /workTime-fornt/employee-profile -> View detailed employee information -> Review attendance-related profile details

features.name: Department Management
features.description: Managers can access the departments area to manage organizational structure and related staffing information.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/departments -> Review existing departments -> Create or update department records

features.name: Attendance Log
features.description: Managers can inspect stored attendance history from the attendance log area.
user_flows: Navigate to /workTime-fornt/attendance-log -> Review attendance history records -> Filter or scan through log entries
